summary: WhiteHawk Minerals Corp. filed an 8-K/A confirming completion of the SJM II Acquisition on September 25, 2026, via indirect subsidiaries WhiteHawk Income Marcellus LLC and WhiteHawk Income Haynesville LLC as Buyers, purchasing mineral, fee mineral, overriding royalty and non-participating royalty interests in the Marcellus and Haynesville shales from Three Rivers Royalty II, LLC and Cypress Mineral Partners, LLC. Aggregate purchase price was $105.0 million, subject to adjustments, with approximately $96.8 million paid at closing. Funding combined Series E Preferred proceeds, a September 21, 2026 private placement of Class A Common Stock, and cash on hand. The Series E ranks senior to common and pays monthly cash dividends; terms beyond that are truncated, and no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch integration, preferred dividend overhang, and dilution from the common placement.
